visualCharacteristics.purpose: Flexible image-only promotional grids with named author-selectable layouts
visualCharacteristics.description: Equal tiles, a large square feature on either side, or a wide feature on either side.

contentPattern.structure: first content row: layout selection; subsequent rows: image with optional destination link in a second cell
contentPattern.description: The first row stores the inspector layout value. Linked images follow in reading order; no nested blocks.

usage: Keep the heading Layout Grid. Store the selected layout, such as Feature Left, in the first content row.
reuseGuidance: Use five images for Feature layouts, three for Wide layouts, or any count for equal columns.
